newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume down.

text.p: Istanbul gold prices ended mixed on Thursday and volume eased to 651 kilos from 703 on Wednesday in sluggish trade amid continuing weak demand, dealers said.
Gold closed at $379.00 an ounce, firming from Wednesday's $378.90 on slightly higher European levels.

But it slid to 1,189,000 lira per gram from 1,193,250 as the lira strengthened against the dollar, closing at 97,440 to the dollar compared to yesterday's 97,770 due to a severe cash shortage in the money market.
Volume traded was 291 kilos in the afternoon session after 360 in the morning. 67 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
